description: Ground-truth eval set for comparing a candidate analysis model (e.g. a self-hosted Qwen3.6-27B) against the real, already-verified behavior of OpenAI's Terra/Sol verification lane on this app's sexual-content taxonomy. Every case here is a real transcript excerpt pulled directly from a production audiobook's saved transcript on the Lambda scanner (via /v1/admin/transcripts/content), not a synthetic example. The first three ACOTAR cases are the exact real incidents found and fixed this session (PR #73 boundary wording, PR #74 Sol majority vote).
